# Database migrations

Alembic migrations for Delphi's PostgreSQL schema.

The database URL is injected at runtime from application settings
(`app.core.config`), so migrations never hardcode credentials and always target
the same database as the running app.

## Common commands

Run from the `backend/` directory:

```bash
# Create a new autogenerated migration after changing ORM models
uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m "describe change"

# Apply migrations
uv run alembic upgrade head

# Roll back one revision
uv run alembic downgrade -1
```

> No business tables exist yet (foundation phase). New ORM models must subclass
> `app.infrastructure.database.base.Base` and be imported in `migrations/env.py`
> (see `target_metadata`) so autogenerate can detect them.
